company.name: Paack
company.shortDescription: Paack is a technology-driven logistics company delivering sustainable, efficient last-mile delivery solutions across Europe.
company.description: Paack is a technology-driven logistics company specializing in sustainable and efficient last-mile delivery solutions across Europe. The company helps retailers and e-commerce businesses improve delivery experiences through advanced technology, real-time tracking, optimized routes, and customer-focused services. Paack focuses on reducing environmental impact by using greener transportation methods and smarter logistics operations. Its platform enables faster, more reliable deliveries while supporting businesses in meeting growing consumer expectations for convenience, transparency, and sustainability.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $10,784,578, or 2.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,957,925 to $1,085,624,771, a 274.29x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 83 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
